title: Body Changes in Your 40s: What Nobody Talks About
description:
🎙️ Next Episode: The Body Changes No One Talks About

Let’s get into it — bodies really start to change in our 40s and up.
It’s a sticky (and yes… hairy 😂) topic, but we’re going there!

Why don’t more people talk about this?
Because the conversations usually stop after periods, pregnancy, and motherhood.
No one prepares you for what comes next.
But we’re living it — and we’re ready to talk.

💬 Got questions about what your body’s going through? Drop them now — we just might share them on the podcast.
Let’s open up this convo together. 💛
